name: The Confessional
source:
You are welcomed into an old church late at night, where what awaits you is a simple conversation with the priest in the confessional.

[From [url=https://labyrintheexe.itch.io/the-confessional]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
深夜，你被迎进一座古老的教堂。等着你的，不过是告解室里和神父的一场简单交谈。

［取自[url=https://labyrintheexe.itch.io/the-confessional]itch.io[/url]］
